I am going to round the number 3.14159 to the nearest whole number
```{r}
round(3.14159)
```
3.14159 rounded to the nearest whole number = 3

 I am going to repeat the number 5 7 times, first by specifying arguments in order and then using their names.
 
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
```
```{r}
print(rep(x=5,times=7))
```
 
 I am going to create character, numerical and logical variables, print them, then check their classes.
 
```{r}
x<-"I like pizza"
print(x)
print(class(x))
```
 
```{r}
x<-67
print(x)
print(class(x))
```
 
```{r}
x<-TRUE
print(x)
print(class(x))
```
